facts: The theatre opened in 1837 and is described as Australia’s oldest working theatre. Location: 1830s and historical summary.
The theatre underwent reconstruction after a June 1984 fire and reopened in March 1986. It remains an active performing-arts venue, now part of The Hedberg building. Location: 1980s and Today.
